text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Metering sync gateway lag detected. Token ingestion delayed ~35m for a subset of EU ingest nodes. Paging on-call. Incident ID INC-2026-07-mtr-sync

Maria Chen: seeing the alert, jumping in. any customer-facing impact yet?

Tim B: I can confirm increased ingest latency. Counts are queued in kafka partition 12. No consumer error yet, but timestamp offsets show backlog.

SRE Pager: oncall here. Runbook meter-sync-01. I'm running the quick consumer restart on node eu-ingest-03 to drain backlog (step 2). Posting logs as I go.

SRE Pager: ```
2026-07-15T09:03:12Z INFO consumer eu-ingest-03 reconnecting
2026-07-15T09:05:01Z WARN backlog 42k msgs
2026-07-15T09:10:46Z INFO drain rate 1200/s
```

Arun Patel: billing-eng FYI, I'm seeing token deltas that don't match live proxy counts. Some customers got overage flags last 20m from the alerting job that reads the ingested window. Could be duplicate window emit when backlog replayed.

Billing Eng: thanks @Arun. Quick summary from billing side: the reporter job uses sliding windows anchored to event timestamps; delayed events are being processed with late timestamps which triggered the overage rule for ~120 customers in EU. We're throttling notification sends but flags already went out.

CS Ops: we got 3 CSM pings already. Customers reporting unexpected overage emails. Can we suppress notifications and queue a manual reconciliation?

Tim B: yes. Short mitigation: 1) mute notifications for billing-alerts channel 2) disable overage-email-send in the reporter config 3) enable tombstone filter to drop duplicate-window events. Doing 1 & 2 now.

Tim B: ```
# disable email sends
kubectl -n billing set env deploy/reporter OVERAGE_EMAIL=off --record
# mute pager
/ops mute-channel billing-alerts --reason "ingest lag replay"
```

Maria Chen: good. Any indication of counting drift (systematic under/over count per customer) or just late emit leading to transient overage flags?

Billing Eng: initial diffs show both: delayed emits pushed some windows over thresholds, and a small counting drift (~0.3%) due to a malformed checkpoint after a restart on eu-ingest-02 earlier. The checkpoint caused ~4k tokens to be undercounted last 6 hours and then double-counted on replay.

Arun Patel: plan for mitigation: a) suppress notifications (done), b) run targeted backfill reconciliation for affected customers, c) issue temporary credits where appropriate, d) longer-term: add watermarking to reporter to ignore late events beyond 15m.

SRE Pager: backlog draining on eu-ingest-03 and eu-ingest-02, consumer lag down to 6k msgs. Restart on eu-ingest-02 completed at 09:26Z.

SRE Pager: ```
kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy/eu-ingest-02
# tail logs to confirm
kubectl -n ingest logs -f deploy/eu-ingest-02 | grep consumer
```

Tim B: I'm running a quick audit script to produce per-customer delta report for the last 12 hours so we can scope credits. Output will be in S3 /recon/1749654321-deltas.csv once done.

Billing Eng: started a dry-run of reconciliation logic against the delta snapshot: results look like ~120 customers with +1 to +30 token deltas causing the flags. Almost all are in EU region, mostly high-volume customers.

CS Ops: can we craft a short customer message? Suggested: "We observed delayed usage reports causing temporary overage flags. No billing will be applied while we reconcile; we'll follow up with a corrected statement and credits where needed." Thoughts?

Maria Chen: good message. Add ETA: investigation + reconciliation within 4 hours, credits issued within 24 hours. Also include contact link to support.

Alex P: joining handoff for next oncall in ~2h. Any actions I should own after handoff?

Arun Patel: please own reconciliation run and final confirmation that the reporter watermark change is deployed to staging. Also verify no further duplicate-window emits after backlog clears.

SRE Pager: backlog drained to <500 msgs by 09:58Z. Consumer lag stable. Scheduling a watch window for 3h.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: STATUS UPDATE: ingest backlog cleared at 09:58:12Z. Notifications still suppressed. Incident ID INC-2026-07-mtr-sync.

Billing Eng: start reconciliation now. Running job: ```
python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --snapshot s3://recon/1749654321-deltas.csv --apply --dryrun
```

Billing Eng: dry-run indicates safe to auto-apply credits for customers with delta <= 5 tokens; anything larger marked for manual review. Preparing credit batch.

CS Ops: sending hold message to affected CSMs now. Draft: "We're investigating delayed usage reports that caused temporary overage flags. No charges will be applied while we reconcile. We expect a follow-up within 24 hours with any applied credits."

Tim B: opened postmortem ticket INC-2026-07-1749654321 on GH. Root cause candidate: consumer checkpoint bug + aggressive late-event windowing.

Maria Chen: handoff to @Alex P in ~10m. Alex, please escalate to platform if you see replay >10k msgs or new overage flags.

Alex P: acknowledged. I'll be on watch and will take ownership of reconciliation progress and the watermark patch deploy to staging.

SRE Pager: final note: keep notification suppression until reconciliation completes. I'll close the pager after the 3h watch if no regressions.

Maria Chen: thanks team. Great quick triage. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Incident thread closed for now (watching).
